segment.source: NetworkControl filters traffic in a background service; this window only displays and controls it. The window reconnects automatically as soon as the service is running.
Development build: the button above starts the locally built service, or run "dotnet run --project src/NetworkControl.Service".
The system service "NetworkControl" normally starts with the computer. Starting it manually requires administrator rights.
The service is not installed. Run "scripts/install-service.ps1" as administrator.
The service is not running: endpoint {0} does not exist.
The service uses IPC protocol v{0}, but this window expects v{1}. Update both to the same version.
The core service is not available
You can still export a diagnostics package to help find the cause.
This portable package starts the service from the Service folder with administrator rights. Rules and logs are stored in the data folder next to it.
